interpretation: No strict fault trial has an exact applied door on a healthy observed path to the target that avoids coarse root occurrences. Post-fault target reach is verified, but the selected occurrence graph does not provide root-free fault-to-target attribution. Preserve canonical counts pending a scoped rerun or an explicitly justified alternative local-timeline proof.
method: Read canonical offline-causal-audit target_retained trials; join exact observed door event ID to archived per-trial feedback doors; classify occurrence from trace_occurrence or point.occurrence; in_closure is archived target-backward-closure membership. Root occurrence means unscoped:<node>:<epoch>:root. Core target_reached is post-last-fault, but does not itself prove an event-level fault-to-target causal path.

provisional_eligibility.criterion: effective applied door exactly matches site,node,epoch,ordinal/hit of an in-closure healthy non-root door; exact target check is post-last-fault. Strong subset also requires same named non-root occurrence in faulted trace. This is healthy-path admission evidence, not an observed faulted-run path, since fault may alter that path.
provisional_eligibility.root_free_path_method: Directed reachability from healthy door occurrence to an exact TARGET_CHECK anchor using only certainty=observed closure edges and excluding every unscoped:<node>:<epoch>:root vertex; then exact site,node,epoch,ordinal/hit match to applied door, with faulted occurrence non-root.
